vector_memory.semantic_summary: This module implements the `send_notification` tool, which abstracts platform-specific desktop alerting mechanisms. It checks the system platform (Linux or macOS) to invoke native tools like `notify-send` or `osascript`. If no native notifier is available, it falls back to outputting a terminal bell character. Its primary role is providing asynchronous, attention-grabbing feedback to the user during long-running agent tasks.
